Error: MCP error -32602: Input validation error: Invalid arguments for tool getJiraIssue: Required at cloudId
Required at issueIdOrKey

Expected parameters:
  cloudId (string) *required* - Cloud ID (UUID or site URL)
  issueIdOrKey (string) *required* - Issue ID or key (e.g., PROJ-123 or 10000)
  fields (array) - Issue fields to return. When omitted or empty, defaults to: summary, description, status, issuetype, priority, labels, components, assignee, reporter, created, updated, resolution, project. Pass "*all" to return every field (including custom fields). Include "comment" to fetch issue comments in fields.comment.comments.
    items (string)
  fieldsByKeys (boolean) - Whether fields in the request are referenced by field keys instead of IDs.
  expand (string) - Additional issue details to expand in the response (for example, renderedFields or names).
  properties (array) - Issue property keys to include in the response.
    items (string)
  updateHistory (boolean) - Whether to update the user's recently viewed projects/history for this issue request.
  failFast (boolean) - Whether to fail quickly when some fields cannot be loaded instead of partially returning data.
  responseContentFormat (enum: "markdown", "adf") - Content format for body content. Use "markdown" for simplified plain text. Use "adf" (Atlassian Document Format, JSON) for full programmatic fidelity. Defaults vary by tool when omitted.
